Support

Write to us

For any question about the Cat First app, email our support.

catfirstsupport@gmail.com

You can also send an email from the app: “Settings” → “Questions and suggestions”.

No cookies, no data collectionThere are no forms on this site: the email is sent from your own mail app.
Not a substitute for a vet

The information in this app comes from open sources and the experience of cat owners. It does not replace a consultation or an examination by a vet. Decisions about your pet's health and care are the owner's to make — if in any doubt, contact a vet.
